events.did: walked into the hotel lobby where Bella and Grace were waiting, disguised as the blonde Ginny
events.quote_anchor: It wasn’t hard to spot them at the lobby’s edge, bare legs and high heels sticking out from cinched black coats.

events.did: told the three men in the suite that Jimmy had called in the favor and that it would not cut into their fee
events.quote_anchor: “Jimmy called in a favor,” lied June, dredging up the name. “Don’t worry,” she added. “It won’t cut into your fee.”

events.did: cut the throat of the man from the doorway with the paring knife
events.quote_anchor: June shrugged. “Fuck if I know,” she said, sweeping the blade across his throat.

events.did: swapped into the body of the man on the couch so his three shots struck him instead of her
events.quote_anchor: Just in time, she’d swapped sweet Ginny for the good old boy in his half-buttoned shirt.

events.did: shot the man at the window in the shoulder
events.quote_anchor: June rolled her eyes and shot him in the shoulder.

events.did: fired three rounds into the floor-to-ceiling window behind the last man and sent his body over the edge
events.quote_anchor: She fired three rounds into the floor-to-ceiling window at his back.

events.did: shifted back into her own body and poured herself a tumbler of neat whisky
events.quote_anchor: The blond girl melted away, wiped like steam from a shower pane, replaced by auburn hair, fair skin, and a heart-shaped face.

events.did: drank down the whisky and left, having given Victor her word to look into EON
events.quote_anchor: She’d given Victor her word, about looking into EON. And June was good at keeping exactly two things: grudges, and promises.

relations.did: wore the blonde body that Bella had known for years while working as Ginny for the night
relations.quote_anchor: Bella had known her for years—well, not her, but the blonde she’d borrowed for the night.

relations.did: let Grace take the cash off the floor and warned her not to call the cops
relations.quote_anchor: She meant it. But she also meant, Do not pass go. Do not call the cops. Do not make me regret this.

relations.did: boasted that Harry never saw the hostile takeover of his rival club coming, though Harry had hired June because he did
relations.quote_anchor: They were too busy celebrating. Congratulating themselves. Toasting the success of their new venture. A rival club. A hostile takeover.

relations.did: owed Victor her word about looking into EON and was good at keeping her promises
relations.quote_anchor: And June was good at keeping exactly two things: grudges, and promises.

numbers.quote_anchor: The doors opened, spitting them out on the twenty-third floor, and all they had to do was follow the music and the raucous laughter

numbers.did: wondered for the hundredth time why she was still doing the work
numbers.quote_anchor: June locked eyes with her reflection, the stranger staring back, and wondered for the hundredth time why she was still doing this

numbers.did: fired three shots into June’s chest
numbers.quote_anchor: she had just enough time to trade the blonde she’d been wearing right before he fired three shots into her chest.

numbers.did: tasted the spirit for the first time in years
numbers.quote_anchor: June met her eyes—her eyes, green as the surf on a stormy day—and sipped, tasting the spirit for the first time in years.

numbers.did: lay in hundreds curling like dead leaves
numbers.quote_anchor: Grace eyed the cash littering the floor, hundreds curling like dead leaves.
